name: certificate-maker
description: Turn a certificate background image (PNG/JPG) and a list of names into print-ready certificates: place text lines with {column} placeholders by position, size, colour and alignment, and long names shrink to fit automatically. Check empty names, fix the list in the panel, preview the first certificate and export one combined PDF plus one PDF per person. Chinese text uses a font already on your computer. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 用一张证书底图（PNG/JPG）和一份名单批量生成可打印的证书、奖状：用带 {列名} 的文字行设置位置、字号、颜色和对齐，名字太长会自动缩小。检查空名字，在面板里修改名单、预览第一张证书，导出合并的 PDF 和每人一份的 PDF。中文使用电脑上已有的字体。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
